scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text:
You have too many things with you.
Make some space in your inventory and come back. I'll tell you something interesting.

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text:
You seem worn out with all that stuff.
Make some space in your inventory and come back. I'll tell you something interesting.

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text:
Mora villagers ask what good quivers are. They just don't know how the world works.
No wonder they don't know a thing about quivers - spreading jam over leaves all day long.
Please make me a quiver.
What's a quiver?

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text: Finally, someone has appeared who knows the true value of a quiver. I will do it for those who know its worth.

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text:
At last someone appreciates a quiver!
I can make Elven Quivers and Hunting Quivers.
Which do you need?
An Elven Quiver
A Hunting Quiver
I don't need a quiver.

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text: You can buy arrows off the tool merchant next to me.

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text: I don't sell ordinary arrows. These are artisan arrows that can only be purchased here. Would you really recognize its worth, right?

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text: An arrow may be thin and light, but carrying hundreds and thousands of arrows is like carrying a whole log.

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text:
But when you have quivers, you can put arrows in them and save weight and space.
If you're interested in one, I'll stitch one up for you.

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text: Bring more than {0} {1} and I'll make you a quiver.

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text:
Oh, I see you have {0} in your hand!
Are you interested in using a quiver? It's really convenient!

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text: Hey, you don't doubt my skills, do you?

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text: Hey, you don't doubt my skills, do you?

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text: I said I'd accept human coins just for you, and you still don't want to spend the money?

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text: You really don't expect to get your hands on a masterpiece for nothing, do you?

scripts.speaker: Quiver Maker
scripts.text:
Hey, here you are.
There is ^3131FFsomething you need to know^000000 - try to remember it.
